candidate: Train aligned shared-factor ensemble members on graph-edge label-pair composite likelihood during ordinary supervised updates.
raw_logit_pair_variant: Exact factorization into the two existing pooled node distributions; pair loss is endpoint-degree-weighted pooled node CE, so proposed dependency operation disappears.
probability_mixture_pair_variant: Carries aligned cross-node covariance, but its pair training term is established ensemble mixture CE on C² structured examples; graph dependency and coherent product mixture ingredients have direct prior.
pool_boundary: The mixture-pair law has arithmetic probability-mean marginals, whereas current primary softmax(mean raw logits) generally differs. It could only be a clearly separate auxiliary objective/secondary law.
learning_derivation: For edge (u,v), mixture responsibility rho_m=p_m(u,y_u)p_m(v,y_v)/sum_j p_j(u,y_u)p_j(v,y_v); pair-log-loss logit gradient at u is rho_m*(p_m(u)-onehot(y_u)), similarly v. These are ordinary mixture responsibilities.
collapse_boundary: When unrestricted predictors fit all training labels with probability one, both member CE and pair mixture loss attain zero with identical members. Pair loss alone does not require retained diversity.

representative_falsifier.analytical_stop: Raw-logit pair variant equals degree-weighted pooled node CE for every modern-backbone output; a training run cannot falsify this identity.
representative_falsifier.conditional_utility_design: Only if separately reopened for utility: two complete paired mechanism cases, PolyFormer-Mono/Squirrel17 and Polynormer-r/Photo17, fixed native cfg0 and qualified identical starting factors/optimizer, four fixed objectives: existing member CE; plus true-edge mixture pair CE; plus endpoint-degree-matched independent marginal-pair CE; plus label-blind degree-preserving shuffled-edge mixture pair CE. Normalize losses and freeze one weight before outcomes; no grid.
representative_falsifier.required_result: The true-edge objective must improve fixed primary mean-raw-logit node NLL over every matched control in both cases at charged total cost; a gain only in auxiliary pair NLL, hidden spread or a favorable case does not support the current node-predictive claim.
representative_falsifier.scope: One seed per modern case is a mechanism falsifier, not confirmation or population/seed-generalization evidence. Root would freeze meaningful minimum benefit, whole cap and label boundary before any separate run.
representative_falsifier.canonical_failure_preservation: Photo original failed gate remains failed; no task run is opened here.
